title: Rats in the Cellar
summary: Marta the innkeeper has a rat problem. Giant rats. With opinions.
author: Dungeon

phases.text: The Rat King's tails writhe — it fights with desperate fury!

inn.title: The Brass Tankard
inn.speaker: marta
inn.text: "{{hero.name}}, is it? Thank goodness. Somethin' the size of a terrier is eatin' my cellar bare. Fifty gold says you can shift it."

choices.text: "Consider it done." (Head down to the cellar)
"Fifty? Make it sixty and I'll bring you the tail."

success.text: Marta laughs and slides a few coins across the bar. "Sixty, then. Ten now, the rest after."

failure.text: Marta folds her arms. "Fifty. Take it or leave it."

cellar-stairs.title: The Cellar Stairs
cellar-stairs.text: The steps are slick with spilled ale. Below, something skitters.

success.text: You descend quietly, catching the rats unaware.

failure.text: Your boot slips — you clatter down the last few steps and bruise your shoulder.

cellar.title: The Cellar
cellar.text: Eyes gleam between the barrels. Then a mountain of knotted tails heaves itself upright: the Rat King.

victory.text: The last rat squeaks and scatters into the walls. The cellar is yours.

flee.text: You stumble back up the stairs, tail between your legs — figuratively, thankfully.

defeat.text: The world goes soft and dark. You wake in the alley behind the inn, bitten but alive.

spoils.title: Spoils of the Cellar
spoils.text: In the rats' nest you find a small cache of shinies — and one charm of gnawed teeth that is frankly charming.

victory-ending.title: Pest Control
victory-ending.text: Marta counts out your gold and the Brass Tankard serves you free suppers for a week.
victory-ending.epilogue: The cellar is quiet at last, save for the drip of a well-tapped barrel.

inn-retreat.title: A Tactical Withdrawal
inn-retreat.text: Marta sighs and slides you a sympathy ale. "Maybe come back when you've got a bigger stick."
inn-retreat.epilogue: The rats keep the cellar. For now.

thrown-out.title: Bitten and Bruised
thrown-out.text: You wake in the alley with a headache and a new respect for vermin. Marta leaves a bandage on the doorstep.
thrown-out.epilogue: Somewhere below, the Rat King feasts.
